# toucan

> An infinite canvas in the browser (tldraw or Excalidraw) that a person edits by hand while agents edit it through the `toucan` CLI and a built-in Codex chat.

Agents: read AGENTS.md before changing a canvas. A person may be editing at the same time; inspect first, make small keyed edits, never wipe their work.

## Install

Requires Node 22+. Ask the person before installing. Do not `npm install toucan`: that registry name is an unrelated package.

    curl -fsSL https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh

In a project, use `toucan init --open`. Read `toucan guide index` for the topic map. Agents without a shell can use the MCP server (`toucan mcp`) and call `toucan_guide` with topic `index`.

## Docs

- [Agent guide index](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/AGENTS.md): everyday editing rules and links to the topic guides
- [Quick start](https://lavallee.github.io/toucan/quickstart.html): install, connect your agent, first canvas
- [How it works](https://lavallee.github.io/toucan/how-it-works.html): sync, exec relay, headless mode and the trail, chat, security model
- [Extending](https://lavallee.github.io/toucan/extending.html): plugins (extension commands, agent profile sources, plan sources and their protocol), deployment notes, configuration, licences

- [Screenshot review](https://lavallee.github.io/toucan/extending.html#screenshot-review): publish revisions, pin feedback, compare screenshots, and reply through a producer inbox.

## What it does that a drawing tool doesn't

- Agents edit the same canvas people do, through keyed, idempotent helpers and graph imports (Mermaid, JSON Canvas, Excalidraw).
- It runs both ways at once: while an agent works, it hears what people edit, select and comment on, between its steps or with its next command, and builds on it rather than over it.
- A canvas has reflexes: rules that fix what happens to it (text outgrowing a box, a frame cutting off its contents) without calling a model, and ask the agent about what they can't, which it can answer by teaching the canvas a new one (`toucan reflexes`).
- A canvas can show a plan: board, gantt, timeline, dependency-graph and table views of a project kept in a JSON file or another system (through a `toucan-source-NAME` plugin), redrawn when it changes upstream, with a person's drags and edits written back. Agents compose views as small specs (`toucan plan catalog`).

## Source

- [bin/toucan.mjs](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/bin/toucan.mjs): the CLI
- [lib/tg.mjs](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/lib/tg.mjs): the toucan graph and format converters
- [lib/client.mjs](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/lib/client.mjs): Node client for extensions
- [server/index.mjs](https://github.com/lavallee/toucan/blob/main/server/index.mjs): server, sync rooms, exec relay
